name: Halloween in Hollywood
source:
Things have been hard for aspiring screenwriter Martina Alvarez. Ever since she’s moved to Los Angeles three years ago, she’s been pitching her screenplays all over town and has seemingly not progressed an inch. Working as a barista to make ends meet, she’s depressed and losing hope about making her dream come true. This is until her roommate comes home one day with a cunning plan to get her film greenlit.

Halloween in Hollywood is a romantic comedy Yuri Visual Novel and Dating sim. Play as witty writer Martina Alvarez as she manoeuvres her way around epic events on Halloween night as she rubs shoulders with Los Angeles elite to do what she can to get her screenplay produced.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2288840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
立志成為編劇的Martina Alvarez，近來過得很艱難。三年前搬到洛杉磯後，她四處推銷自己的劇本，卻彷彿寸步未進。靠咖啡師的工作勉強維生，她情緒低落，逐漸失去實現夢想的希望。直到某天，室友回到家，提出一個讓她的電影獲准拍攝的巧妙計畫。

《Halloween in Hollywood》是一部百合浪漫喜劇視覺小說兼戀愛模擬遊戲。扮演機智的編劇Martina Alvarez，在萬聖節之夜的一連串盛大活動中周旋，與洛杉磯的上流人士打交道，竭盡所能讓自己的劇本搬上銀幕。
